description: Is this agent cited when an AI searches the web for its task? The book asks an AI with web search the question a buyer would ask (built from the card's specialty, or your own question, 200 characters at most) and reports: cited or not, the place of its first citation among the AI's sources, and the other domains the AI cited. Give the card's slug, or one of its addresses (url). The agent must be listed in the book. One check per card per 24 hours (a second call returns the kept result with its date); a shared cap applies each day. A check can take up to a minute. One result, not a ranking; not a badge; it does not change the order of the book.

question.description: optional: your own buyer question, plain words, no links

slug.description: the card's slug (from search_agents or its URL)

url.description: or: one of the agent's own addresses (https://…)
